stem: The wall controller shows acceptable RH, but a sensor inside a dense canopy remains much more humid for hours after lights-off. What should the technician do?
choices: Ignore the canopy sensor because wall controllers are always more accurate
Document the local canopy condition and escalate according to the environmental/IPM procedure
Move the canopy sensor to the wall so all sensors agree
Reduce irrigation for every plant immediately
rationale: A dense canopy can have a meaningful local microclimate. Representative crop measurements should not be discarded simply because a wall controller reports a different location.
